readMeFirst: The methods, their declared shapes and the two tables of the r6b auto-loop, copied so that tools/lib/select-method.mjs can replay its choice of method without a compiler. A method is a repair a person wrote; a table row says which method a (compiler, stage, shape) cell goes to and cites the run it was taken from. Nothing here was measured in this tree: the claims were copied from the plugins' own descriptions, and the table rows cite lab runs outside it. See README.md, *Choosing the next method*.

copiedFrom.where: lab notes outside this repository (no file of this tree holds them): poster/v44/exp_loop2/
copiedFrom.loopSha16Means: the first 16 hex digits of SHA-256 over JSON.stringify of the parsed table, which is how the r6b loop records name the table they used
copiedFrom.selectionSha16Means: the first 16 hex digits of SHA-256 over JSON.stringify of [cc, stage, shape, method] for each row of the table, in order, computed from the file copied from (2026-11-09); tools/select-method.mjs recomputes it from the copied rows and refuses a loop file whose table copy differs (exit 5)
copiedFrom.changed: translated to English; the plugin paths (machine-specific) left out; nothing else. The sha256 of the two plugin builds the loop used is kept per method as pluginSha16.

wipepin-volatile.source: compiler/llvm-repair/README.md: make the zero-fill llvm.memset intrinsics of the named functions volatile

wipepin-barrier.source: the r5 barrier patch plus the r6b bzero patch, both outside this tree when the loop ran: an asm barrier directly after a zero-fill memset.inline, __memset_chk, memset, bzero or bzero.<suffix> call (compiler/schema/wipe-pin.md §14.4 is that switch's contract)

wipepingcc.source: compiler/gcc-repair/README.md: an asm barrier directly after the zero-fill __builtin_memset of the named functions

wipepingcc-barrier.source: the r6b gcc patch, outside this tree when the loop ran: the same barrier after a zero-fill __builtin___memset_chk and after a bzero call

sourceSideShapesFrom: a copy of r6b's, made when the loop ran (2026-10-04): in pin-families.json as it stood then, the shape whose only row was not-repairable-in-compiler. Since 2026-11-09 that shape has two buffer-barrier rows instead (WPIN_BUFFER_BARRIER=1) and no such row, so this list replays r6b and does not describe the current table; a loop over wipe-pin-v3 records reads pin-families.json again (tools/lib/select-method.mjs, selectMethod)

cold.note: the table before the first run: one row per vendor for the shape its plugin was written for

learned.note: the cold rows plus the rows learn.py adopted from E1's L2 cells (data/e1/loop-cold.json); fixed for E2, E3 and E4.
